<thought>From the ¹H NMR data: a singlet at 1.79 ppm integrates to 3 H (one CH₃), a singlet at 1.92 ppm integrates to 6 H (two equivalent CH₃ groups), and a singlet at 2.67 ppm integrates to 6 H (another two equivalent CH₃ groups). Summing gives 1 + 2 + 2 = 5 methyl groups.</thought>
<final_answer>5</final_answer>
